profile.reading:
This building, SV3, is part of CoreSite's Santa Clara sub-campus at 2901 Coronado Drive, Santa Clara, CA 95054, per public property records; CoreSite does not currently publish a dedicated facility page or spec sheet for SV3, unlike SV1, SV4, SV7, SV8, and SV9, which do have live pages. SV3 is named as an existing campus building in a CoreSite press release about the broader Santa Clara campus, confirming it is a real, operating facility even without individual marketing content, so this entry does not assert an unconfirmed square footage or MW figure for it specifically.

CoreSite's Santa Clara sub-campus (SV3 through SV9) is described in a CoreSite construction-approval release as exceeding 775,000 square feet combined, part of a nine-building, 1.4-million-plus-square-foot Silicon Valley presence spanning San Jose, Santa Clara, and Milpitas. CoreSite is a subsidiary of American Tower Corporation (NYSE: AMT), which completed its acquisition of CoreSite in late 2021; Stonepeak Partners LP separately acquired roughly 29% of American Tower's US data center business in July 2022, later increased to about 36%. CoreSite's own site describes a total portfolio of 30 data centers across 11 US markets totaling more than 4.8 million square feet.

American Tower reported record leasing at CoreSite driving stronger-than-expected second-quarter 2026 results, projecting data-center segment revenue of $1.20 billion to $1.22 billion for full-year 2026, roughly 14.9% growth at the midpoint, and raising its full-year outlook on the strength of that performance; the company also budgeted approximately $695 million in data-center development spending for 2026, funding continued build-out including additional Santa Clara campus capacity beyond the currently marketed SV1/SV4/SV7/SV8/SV9 buildings.

reading.body:
CoreSite SV3 is a 50,000 square foot building at the Santa Clara sub-campus of CoreSite's Silicon Valley presence, confirmed as an operating facility in company press releases but without published power or IT capacity specifications. The operator does not maintain a dedicated facility page for SV3, unlike five other buildings at the same Santa Clara address that do publish their specs, making this building's compute footprint opaque to public assessment. CoreSite's broader Santa Clara campus exceeds 775,000 square feet across nine buildings as part of a 1.4-million-square-foot Silicon Valley footprint, but no individual power figure has been published for SV3 by the operator or reported by major aggregators.

CoreSite, acquired by American Tower Corporation in late 2021, operates 30 data centers across 11 US markets totaling more than 4.8 million square feet. American Tower reported record leasing at CoreSite in second-quarter 2026 and raised its full-year guidance on that strength, with the company budgeting approximately $695 million in data center development spending for 2026 to fund continued build-out including additional Santa Clara campus capacity. The published capacity across California's 103 mapped data center facilities totals 365 MW, of which only 11 facilities publish figures; CoreSite's published properties in the state rank 12th by megawatts but SV3's individual contribution remains unknown.

Without published power specifications, SV3 cannot be ranked among California's capacity-constrained sites or assessed for its role in AI scaling. The absence of a dedicated operator spec sheet, unusual among CoreSite's Santa Clara buildings, leaves the building's current utilization and future buildout plans unquantified. Whether SV3 functions as active capacity, shell space for future fit-out, or expansion reserve remains outside what CoreSite has disclosed.
